quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: firm-fixed-price and cost-plus-fixed-fee contract N66001-26-C-0021 to L3 Technologies Inc. (Camden, New Jersey) for procurement, assembly, integration, configuration and shipment of communications equipment and components; 15 options would bring potential value to an estimated $74,935,753; work in Camden, expected completion March 2030 with all options; sole-source follow-on production award; contracting activity Naval Information Warfare Center Pacific, San Diego.

DoD award: firm-fixed-price definitization contracting action (FA254126CB014PZ004) to L3Harris (Greenville, Texas) to provide commercial satellite communications connectivity for designated executive airlift aircraft; expected completion Oct. 31, 2028; sole source; fiscal 2026 O&M funds of $62,305,059 obligated at award; contracting activity Space Force Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Satellite Communications and Positioning, Navigation, and Timing, Los Angeles Air Force Base.

DoD award: cost-plus-fixed-fee contract W900KK-26-C-A030 to Aerojet Rocketdyne Inc. (Jupiter, Florida) to modernize and expand hypersonic test infrastructure; one bid received; estimated completion Sept. 28, 2028; contracting activity Army Contracting Command, Orlando, Florida.
